title: OpenToM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Theory-of-Mind Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Computing the difference in F1 scores between models' performance on mover-centric questions versus observer-centric questions to identify performance gaps and bias towards protagonists.

Calculating the proportion of error cases in attitude deduction questions that erroneously correlate with the mover's personality trait, evaluating if models rely on shortcuts rather than true Theory-of-Mind reasoning.
